Replied in your thread in #inc-vtg-hartford.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. Between that and the 11:03 AM kiosk 1 recovery, the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 11:03 message says the guard then checked in trailer 8836, which dispatch could see. Both lanes were back as of 11:07, per your 11:08 message.
